name: Candle Apothecary (Retail)
tagline: A moody, working storefront for a candle apothecary.
description: A complete, working shop for a candle & home-fragrance apothecary: a real catalogue of hand-poured signature candles, a reed diffuser, a room mist, a wax-melt set, candle-care accessories and a gift set, with categories, collections, a bespoke candlelit PDP and a full merchandised home page. Moody apothecary theme — warm charcoal ground, ember accent, a characterful serif. Shipped as Ember & Ash.
